@deskSetFrameTransactions.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name for how payments are made: the methods, what Send starts on, receiving. Narrow (about 200 px).

@deskSetTxMethods.description: Payments: heading of the payment method switches.

deskSetTxEpicboxHint: Pay and get paid through an Epicbox server; most payments go this way. When off, no Epicbox server is contacted: no Epicbox payments or invoices, other methods still work. All wallets.

@deskSetTxEpicboxHint.description: Hover card behind the info icon of the Epicbox row on Settings › Transactions.

deskSetTxDirectHint: Wallet-to-wallet payments at a web address (http://host:{port}), with no server between. Both wallets must be open; off while Tor is on. Adds Link · HTTP to Send and its address to Receive. All wallets.

@deskSetTxDirectHint.description: Hover card behind the info icon of the Link › HTTP row (switch) on Settings › Transactions.

deskSetTxFileHint: Pay and get paid by handing over a payment file, with no network needed. Adds File Transfer to Send and the file steps to Receive. All wallets.

@deskSetTxFileHint.description: Hover card behind the info icon of the File row (switch) on Settings › Transactions.

@deskSetTxStart.description: Row title on Settings › Transactions: the payment method the Send page opens with. The control lists the methods that are on.

deskSetTxStartHint: The method Send opens with; it can be changed for each payment. All wallets.

@deskSetTxStartHint.description: Hover card behind the info icon of the Send starts on row.

deskSetTxLastMethod: Keep at least one payment method on.

@deskSetTxLastMethod.description: Toast when the last payment method that is on is switched off on Settings › Transactions: the switch stays on.

@deskSetTxSending.description: Payments: heading of the Default method and send option rows.

deskSetTxTorPayHint: Tor runs only to send and receive payments at the Tor address. The node, prices and updates keep the setting under Network & privacy. All wallets.

@deskSetTxTorPayHint.description: Info text of Payments › Link · Tor. "All wallets": the switch is app-wide.
